NGC 5866.uncertainty_note: Near-edge-on lenticular Spindle Galaxy with a central dust lane. Distance and stellar mass are literature estimates; the dust opacity, bulge profile, colors and core gravity are approximate. The measured disk inclination is adopted independently of the rounder bulge-dominated isophotal axis ratio. SIMBAD also identifies this object as M 102.
